text:
maria: Heads up — noticing a weird drop in webinar -> trial conversion on this week's performance ledger. numbers look off compared to last month. Can someone sanity-check the attribution window and filters?
jon: Yup saw that, conversion from webinar landing is 3.2% vs 7.4 last week :confused: — dashboard link https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/WD-8aBc
deepa: Which source are you looking at, GA or our internal events pipeline? Could be event duplicates or missing utm tags.
maria: Internal dashboard (growth.kpis > conversions by campaign). I filtered by campaign name "MarWebinar_2026" — wonder if there was a naming change.
samir: I can run a quick query. My hunch: inconsistent utm_campaign casing or dash vs underscore. Running: ```sql
SELECT utm_campaign, count(distinct lead_id) AS leads, sum(is_trial) AS trials
FROM events_raw
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-20'
AND event_name = 'webinar_signup'
GROUP BY utm_campaign
ORDER BY leads DESC;
```
BI-bot: Query ran (sample): utm_campaign values found: ["MarWebinar_2026", "mar-webinar-2026", "MarWebinar2026", null] — trials/leads: [45/820, 12/190, 0/3, 5/30]
ellie: That null bucket is worrying — could be some registrants coming via organic retargeting or old landing page without tracking :eyes:
jon: If the dashboard filter only matches exact "MarWebinar_2026" we miss the mar-webinar row which had a higher trial rate. That could explain drop.
maria: Could we normalize utm_campaign in the ETL or use a canonical mapping in the dashboard? Prefer a quick fix in the dashboard so weekly KPI report isn't blocked.
samir: I can add a computed field in the BI view: `regexp_replace(lower(utm_campaign), "[^a-z0-9]", "_")` then map to canonical value. Quick patch, push in 20m.
deepa: I'll also check GA and the landing page tags — maybe marketing changed the link in the event invite. If GA shows consistent campaign, we can adopt that as source of truth.
ellie: For the weekly report, can someone update the chart to use the normalized field and re-run the webhook funnel? I can republish the deck after.
jon: Also, let's note for postmortem: add a pre-launch checklist item for UTM naming and landing page sync. Saved us from future surprises. :memo:
maria: Thanks all. Action items: 1) Samir normalizes and pushes BI view (eta 20m). 2) Deepa verifies GA tags (eta 2h). 3) Ellie republish KPI deck once snapshot updated. I'll hold the executive summary until we confirm. :thumbsup:
BI-bot: Patch deployed to staging view. New normalized counts: combined MarWebinar rows -> leads 1045, trials 62 => conv 5.9% (reconciles closer to prior weeks).
maria: Great — that's much closer. I'll update the weekly pulse and note attribution caveat.
deepa: Found one broken redirect on the old landing page causing loss of utm params. Filed PR with engineering to patch.
ellie: Updated deck and sent to execs at 15:42 with a short note about attribution normalization.
samir: Logging the regex mapping in the data dictionary: `campaign_normalized = regexp_replace(lower(utm_campaign), "[^a-z0-9]", "_")` — will add a rule for known aliases.
maria: Closing thread here. Thanks for the quick triage :rocket:
